cluster-info-collector/makefile.candidate: Running `make` with no target prints the list of targets with their descriptions (help is the default goal)
`make build` builds the image tagged $(IMAGE):$(VERSION), default fabiocicerchia/cluster-info-collector:0.1.0
`make lint` runs every pre-commit hook on all files. The target's description says 'Run the whole gate', which differs from the 'hadolint + shellcheck' wording in CLAUDE.md
`make test` builds the image, runs the unit tests and then the smoke test. Its 'Build + smoke test' description leaves out the unit-test step
`make test-unit` runs ./test-unit.sh and needs neither docker nor kubectl
`make install` puts cluster-collect (mode 0755), its man page and lib.sh under DESTDIR/PREFIX. PREFIX has no default, so a bare `make install` writes to /bin, /share/man and /lib
`make uninstall` removes the files that `make install` put down
`make run` builds the image and runs the collector in it, passing ARGS through
`make format` runs the whitespace, end-of-file and line-ending fixer hooks and ignores their non-zero exits
`make analyze` runs a trivy fs scan for CRITICAL and HIGH vulnerabilities, misconfigurations and secrets. If trivy is missing it exits 69 with a pointer to the install docs
`make push` builds and pushes the single-arch image tagged with VERSION
`make release` builds and pushes a linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 image tagged with both VERSION and latest
